    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import networkx as nx\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_roads(grid_size):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成一个简单的城市道路网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 创建一个网格图\n",
    "    G = nx.grid_2d_graph(grid_size, grid_size)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 设置节点的坐标\n",
    "    pos = {(x, y): (x, y) for x, y in G.nodes()}\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 绘制网格图\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))\n",
    "    nx.draw(G, pos, with_labels=False, node_size=10, node_color=\"blue\", edge_color=\"gray\")\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"城市道路网格 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成城市道路\n",
    "generate_city_roads(grid_size=10)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import networkx as nx\n",
    "import random\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size, road_probability=0.7):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成一个带有随机道路和建筑物的城市网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    :param road_probability: 每条边作为道路的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 创建一个网格图\n",
    "    G = nx.grid_2d_graph(grid_size, grid_size)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 随机移除一些边以模拟非规则道路\n",
    "    edges_to_remove = [\n",
    "        edge for edge in G.edges()\n",
    "        if random.random() > road_probability\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "    G.remove_edges_from(edges_to_remove)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 设置节点的坐标\n",
    "    pos = {(x, y): (x, y) for x, y in G.nodes()}\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 绘制网格图\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))\n",
    "    nx.draw(\n",
    "        G, pos, with_labels=False, node_size=10, node_color=\"blue\", edge_color=\"gray\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 在没有道路的节点之间随机生成建筑物\n",
    "    for node in G.nodes():\n",
    "        if all(neighbor not in G[node] for neighbor in G.nodes()):\n",
    "            plt.scatter(*pos[node], color=\"red\", s=50, label=\"建筑物\" if node == (0, 0) else \"\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机城市道路和建筑物 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.legend(loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成随机城市道路和建筑物\n",
    "generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7)"
   ]
  },

    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import networkx as nx\n",
    "import random\n",

    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.3):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成一个带有随机道路和建筑物的城市网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    :param road_probability: 每条边作为道路的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    :param building_probability: 每条边生成建筑物的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 创建一个网格图\n",
    "    G = nx.grid_2d_graph(grid_size, grid_size)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 随机移除一些边以模拟非规则道路\n",
    "    edges_to_remove = [\n",
    "        edge for edge in G.edges()\n",
    "        if random.random() > road_probability\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "    G.remove_edges_from(edges_to_remove)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 设置节点的坐标\n",
    "    pos = {(x, y): (x, y) for x, y in G.nodes()}\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 绘制网格图\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))\n",
    "    nx.draw(\n",
    "        G, pos, with_labels=False, node_size=10, node_color=\"blue\", edge_color=\"gray\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 在道路之间随机生成建筑物\n",
    "    for edge in G.edges():\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            # 计算边的中点\n",
    "            x1, y1 = pos[edge[0]]\n",
    "            x2, y2 = pos[edge[1]]\n",
    "            mid_x, mid_y = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "            plt.scatter(mid_x, mid_y, color=\"red\", s=50, label=\"建筑物\" if edge == list(G.edges())[0] else \"\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机城市道路和建筑物 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.legend(loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成随机城市道路和建筑物\n",
    "generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.3)"

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import networkx as nx\n",
    "import random\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.3):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成一个带有随机道路和建筑物的城市网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    :param road_probability: 每条边作为道路的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    :param building_probability: 每条边生成建筑物的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 创建一个网格图\n",
    "    G = nx.grid_2d_graph(grid_size, grid_size)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 随机移除一些边以模拟非规则道路\n",
    "    edges_to_remove = [\n",
    "        edge for edge in G.edges()\n",
    "        if random.random() > road_probability\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "    G.remove_edges_from(edges_to_remove)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 设置节点的坐标\n",
    "    pos = {(x, y): (x, y) for x, y in G.nodes()}\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 绘制网格图\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))\n",
    "    nx.draw(\n",
    "        G, pos, with_labels=False, node_size=10, node_color=\"blue\", edge_color=\"gray\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 在道路之间随机生成建筑物\n",
    "    for edge in G.edges():\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            # 计算边的中点\n",
    "            x1, y1 = pos[edge[0]]\n",
    "            x2, y2 = pos[edge[1]]\n",
    "            mid_x, mid_y = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 随机生成建筑物的长宽\n",
    "            width = random.uniform(0.2, 0.5)\n",
    "            height = random.uniform(0.2, 0.5)\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 绘制建筑物轮廓（矩形）\n",
    "            plt.gca().add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "                (mid_x - width / 2, mid_y - height / 2),  # 左下角坐标\n",
    "                width,  # 宽度\n",
    "                height,  # 高度\n",
    "                color=\"red\",\n",
    "                alpha=0.6,\n",
    "                label=\"建筑物\" if edge == list(G.edges())[0] else \"\"\n",
    "            ))\n",
    "    \n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机城市道路和建筑物 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.legend(loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "    plt.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成随机城市道路和建筑物\n",
    "generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.3)"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import networkx as nx\n",
    "import random\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.3):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成一个带有随机道路和建筑物的城市网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    :param road_probability: 每条边作为道路的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    :param building_probability: 每条边生成建筑物的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 创建一个网格图\n",
    "    G = nx.grid_2d_graph(grid_size, grid_size)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 随机移除一些边以模拟非规则道路\n",
    "    edges_to_remove = [\n",
    "        edge for edge in G.edges()\n",
    "        if random.random() > road_probability\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "    G.remove_edges_from(edges_to_remove)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 设置节点的坐标\n",
    "    pos = {(x, y): (x, y) for x, y in G.nodes()}\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 绘制网格图\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))\n",
    "    nx.draw(\n",
    "        G, pos, with_labels=False, node_size=10, node_color=\"blue\", edge_color=\"gray\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 在道路之间随机生成建筑物\n",
    "    for edge in G.edges():\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            # 计算边的中点\n",
    "            x1, y1 = pos[edge[0]]\n",
    "            x2, y2 = pos[edge[1]]\n",
    "            mid_x, mid_y = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 随机生成建筑物的长宽\n",
    "            width = random.uniform(0.2, 0.5)\n",
    "            height = random.uniform(0.2, 0.5)\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 偏移建筑物中心，确保建筑物不与道路重合\n",
    "            offset_x = random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)\n",
    "            offset_y = random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)\n",
    "            building_center_x = mid_x + offset_x\n",
    "            building_center_y = mid_y + offset_y\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 绘制建筑物轮廓（矩形）\n",
    "            plt.gca().add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "                (building_center_x - width / 2, building_center_y - height / 2),  # 左下角坐标\n",
    "                width,  # 宽度\n",
    "                height,  # 高度\n",
    "                color=\"red\",\n",
    "                alpha=0.6,\n",
    "                label=\"建筑物\" if edge == list(G.edges())[0] else \"\"\n",
    "            ))\n",
    "    \n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机城市道路和建筑物 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.legend(loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "    plt.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成随机城市道路和建筑物\n",
    "generate_city_roads_with_buildings(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.3)"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import random\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置随机种子，确保结果可复现\n",
    "random.seed(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成城市道路和建筑物的网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    :param road_probability: 每条边作为道路的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    :param building_probability: 每条边生成建筑物的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 初始化道路和建筑物数据\n",
    "    roads = []\n",
    "    buildings = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历网格，生成横向和纵向道路\n",
    "    for x in range(grid_size):\n",
    "        for y in range(grid_size):\n",
    "            # 横向道路\n",
    "            if x < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x + 1, y), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"main\"}))\n",
    "            # 纵向道路\n",
    "            if y < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x, y + 1), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"secondary\"}))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历道路，生成建筑物\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2\n",
    "        mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            # 随机生成建筑物属性\n",
    "            building = {\n",
    "                \"center\": (mid_x + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3), mid_y + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)),\n",
    "                \"width\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"height\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"floors\": random.randint(1, 5),\n",
    "                \"function\": random.choice([\"residential\", \"commercial\", \"industrial\"]),\n",
    "                \"year_built\": random.randint(1950, 2025)\n",
    "            }\n",
    "            buildings.append(building)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制城市网格\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制道路\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        plt.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], color=\"gray\", linewidth=road_data[\"width\"] * 10, alpha=0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        plt.gca().add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),  # 左下角坐标\n",
    "            width,  # 宽度\n",
    "            height,  # 高度\n",
    "            color=\"red\",\n",
    "            alpha=0.6\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机生成的城市网格 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 输出建筑物属性数据\n",
    "    for i, building in enumerate(buildings, 1):\n",
    "        print(f\"建筑物 {i}: {building}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成城市\n",
    "generate_city(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# 基本内容：（1）确保每次随机的结果可以复现，应该设置具体的随机种子；（2）我希望重写道路和建筑轮廓的生成逻辑：首先是道路，它是随机生成的横平竖直的线（其中包含道路的宽度、级别和功能等属性），然后才是建筑物及其轮廓，建筑物是在道路边依次建设的，且其轮廓不能与道路重合（实际不允许，物理因素等），再然后建筑也应该包含其属性数据，比如层高、层数、建筑功能、建筑年份等等；（3）综上内容，重新分步骤撰写代码并进行详细注释。谢谢！\n",
    "\n",
    "# 补充内容：（1）注意，建筑物与道路不能重叠，建筑物与建筑物之间也不能重叠。（2）按照上述的要求，先生成这些建筑和道路的数据并以表格的形式显示出来，然后再进行随后的工作们。（3）根据不同的道路和建筑属性，采用不同的颜色展示它们的关系。"
   ]
  },

    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import random\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置随机种子，确保结果可复现\n",
    "random.seed(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成城市道路和建筑物的网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    :param road_probability: 每条边作为道路的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    :param building_probability: 每条边生成建筑物的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 初始化道路和建筑物数据\n",
    "    roads = []\n",
    "    buildings = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历网格，生成横向和纵向道路\n",
    "    for x in range(grid_size):\n",
    "        for y in range(grid_size):\n",
    "            # 横向道路\n",
    "            if x < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x + 1, y), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"main\"}))\n",
    "            # 纵向道路\n",
    "            if y < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x, y + 1), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"secondary\"}))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历道路，生成建筑物\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2\n",
    "        mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            # 随机生成建筑物属性\n",
    "            building = {\n",
    "                \"center\": (mid_x + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3), mid_y + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)),\n",
    "                \"width\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"height\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"floors\": random.randint(1, 5),\n",
    "                \"function\": random.choice([\"residential\", \"commercial\", \"industrial\"]),\n",
    "                \"year_built\": random.randint(1950, 2025)\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "            # 确保建筑物不与其他建筑物重叠\n",
    "            overlap = False\n",
    "            for existing_building in buildings:\n",
    "                ex_center_x, ex_center_y = existing_building[\"center\"]\n",
    "                ex_width, ex_height = existing_building[\"width\"], existing_building[\"height\"]\n",
    "                if abs(building[\"center\"][0] - ex_center_x) < (building[\"width\"] + ex_width) / 2 and \\\n",
    "                   abs(building[\"center\"][1] - ex_center_y) < (building[\"height\"] + ex_height) / 2:\n",
    "                    overlap = True\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "            if not overlap:\n",
    "                buildings.append(building)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 将道路和建筑物数据转换为表格\n",
    "    road_data = [{\"start\": road[0], \"end\": road[1], \"width\": road[2][\"width\"], \"type\": road[2][\"type\"]} for road in roads]\n",
    "    building_data = [{\"center\": building[\"center\"], \"width\": building[\"width\"], \"height\": building[\"height\"],\n",
    "                      \"floors\": building[\"floors\"], \"function\": building[\"function\"], \"year_built\": building[\"year_built\"]}\n",
    "                     for building in buildings]\n",
    "\n",
    "    road_df = pd.DataFrame(road_data)\n",
    "    building_df = pd.DataFrame(building_data)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"道路数据：\")\n",
    "    print(road_df)\n",
    "    print(\"\\n建筑物数据：\")\n",
    "    print(building_df)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制城市网格\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制道路\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        color = \"black\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"gray\"\n",
    "        plt.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], color=color, linewidth=road_data[\"width\"] * 10, alpha=0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        color = {\"residential\": \"blue\", \"commercial\": \"green\", \"industrial\": \"orange\"}[building[\"function\"]]\n",
    "        plt.gca().add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),  # 左下角坐标\n",
    "            width,  # 宽度\n",
    "            height,  # 高度\n",
    "            color=color,\n",
    "            alpha=0.6\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机生成的城市网格 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成城市\n",
    "generate_city(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5)"
   ]
  },

    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",

    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置随机种子，确保结果可复现\n",
    "random.seed(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成城市道路和建筑物的网格。\n",
    "    \n",
    "    :param grid_size: 城市网格的大小 (n x n)\n",
    "    :param road_probability: 每条边作为道路的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    :param building_probability: 每条边生成建筑物的概率 (0 到 1)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 初始化道路和建筑物数据\n",
    "    roads = []\n",
    "    buildings = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历网格，生成横向和纵向道路\n",
    "    for x in range(grid_size):\n",
    "        for y in range(grid_size):\n",
    "            # 横向道路\n",
    "            if x < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x + 1, y), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"main\"}))\n",
    "            # 纵向道路\n",
    "            if y < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x, y + 1), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"secondary\"}))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历道路，生成建筑物\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2\n",
    "        mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            # 随机生成建筑物属性\n",
    "            building = {\n",
    "                \"center\": (mid_x + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3), mid_y + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)),\n",
    "                \"width\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"height\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"floors\": random.randint(1, 5),\n",
    "                \"function\": random.choice([\"residential\", \"commercial\", \"industrial\"]),\n",
    "                \"year_built\": random.randint(1950, 2025)\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "            # 确保建筑物不与其他建筑物重叠\n",
    "            overlap = False\n",
    "            for existing_building in buildings:\n",
    "                ex_center_x, ex_center_y = existing_building[\"center\"]\n",
    "                ex_width, ex_height = existing_building[\"width\"], existing_building[\"height\"]\n",
    "                if abs(building[\"center\"][0] - ex_center_x) < (building[\"width\"] + ex_width) / 2 and \\\n",
    "                   abs(building[\"center\"][1] - ex_center_y) < (building[\"height\"] + ex_height) / 2:\n",
    "                    overlap = True\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "            if not overlap:\n",
    "                buildings.append(building)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 将道路和建筑物数据转换为表格\n",
    "    road_data = [{\"start\": road[0], \"end\": road[1], \"width\": road[2][\"width\"], \"type\": road[2][\"type\"]} for road in roads]\n",
    "    building_data = [{\"center\": building[\"center\"], \"width\": building[\"width\"], \"height\": building[\"height\"],\n",
    "                      \"floors\": building[\"floors\"], \"function\": building[\"function\"], \"year_built\": building[\"year_built\"]}\n",
    "                     for building in buildings]\n",
    "\n",
    "    road_df = pd.DataFrame(road_data)\n",
    "    building_df = pd.DataFrame(building_data)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"道路数据：\")\n",
    "    print(road_df)\n",
    "    print(\"\\n建筑物数据：\")\n",
    "    print(building_df)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制城市网格\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制道路\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        color = \"black\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"gray\"\n",
    "        plt.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], color=color, linewidth=road_data[\"width\"] * 10, alpha=0.8,\n",
    "                 label=\"主路\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"次路\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        color = {\"residential\": \"blue\", \"commercial\": \"green\", \"industrial\": \"orange\"}[building[\"function\"]]\n",
    "        plt.gca().add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),  # 左下角坐标\n",
    "            width,  # 宽度\n",
    "            height,  # 高度\n",
    "            color=color,\n",
    "            alpha=0.6,\n",
    "            label={\"blue\": \"住宅\", \"green\": \"商业\", \"orange\": \"工业\"}[color]\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 添加图例\n",
    "    handles, labels = plt.gca().get_legend_handles_labels()\n",
    "    by_label = dict(zip(labels, handles))  # 去重\n",
    "    plt.legend(by_label.values(), by_label.keys(), loc=\"upper right\", bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 1.0))\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机生成的城市网格 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成城市\n",
    "generate_city(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5)"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import random\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置随机种子，确保结果可复现\n",
    "random.seed(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_energy_consumption(building):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    根据建筑属性计算能源消耗。\n",
    "    能耗公式：能耗 = 面积 * 层数 * 功能系数 * 年份系数\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    area = building[\"width\"] * building[\"height\"]\n",
    "    floors = building[\"floors\"]\n",
    "    function_factor = {\"residential\": 1.0, \"commercial\": 1.5, \"industrial\": 2.0}[building[\"function\"]]\n",
    "    year_factor = 1.0 if building[\"year_built\"] >= 2000 else 1.2  # 2000年后建筑更节能\n",
    "    energy_consumption = area * floors * function_factor * year_factor\n",
    "    return energy_consumption\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_with_energy(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成城市道路和建筑物的网格，并计算建筑物的能源消耗。\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 初始化道路和建筑物数据\n",
    "    roads = []\n",
    "    buildings = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历网格，生成横向和纵向道路\n",
    "    for x in range(grid_size):\n",
    "        for y in range(grid_size):\n",
    "            # 横向道路\n",
    "            if x < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x + 1, y), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"main\"}))\n",
    "            # 纵向道路\n",
    "            if y < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x, y + 1), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"secondary\"}))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历道路，生成建筑物\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2\n",
    "        mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            # 随机生成建筑物属性\n",
    "            building = {\n",
    "                \"center\": (mid_x + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3), mid_y + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)),\n",
    "                \"width\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"height\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"floors\": random.randint(1, 5),\n",
    "                \"function\": random.choice([\"residential\", \"commercial\", \"industrial\"]),\n",
    "                \"year_built\": random.randint(1950, 2025)\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "            # 确保建筑物不与其他建筑物重叠\n",
    "            overlap = False\n",
    "            for existing_building in buildings:\n",
    "                ex_center_x, ex_center_y = existing_building[\"center\"]\n",
    "                ex_width, ex_height = existing_building[\"width\"], existing_building[\"height\"]\n",
    "                if abs(building[\"center\"][0] - ex_center_x) < (building[\"width\"] + ex_width) / 2 and \\\n",
    "                   abs(building[\"center\"][1] - ex_center_y) < (building[\"height\"] + ex_height) / 2:\n",
    "                    overlap = True\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "            if not overlap:\n",
    "                buildings.append(building)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 计算每栋建筑的能源消耗\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        building[\"energy_consumption\"] = calculate_energy_consumption(building)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 将建筑物数据转换为表格\n",
    "    building_data = [{\"center\": building[\"center\"], \"width\": building[\"width\"], \"height\": building[\"height\"],\n",
    "                      \"floors\": building[\"floors\"], \"function\": building[\"function\"], \"year_built\": building[\"year_built\"],\n",
    "                      \"energy_consumption\": building[\"energy_consumption\"]}\n",
    "                     for building in buildings]\n",
    "\n",
    "    building_df = pd.DataFrame(building_data)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n建筑物数据：\")\n",
    "    print(building_df)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制城市网格\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        color = {\"residential\": \"blue\", \"commercial\": \"green\", \"industrial\": \"orange\"}[building[\"function\"]]\n",
    "        plt.gca().add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),  # 左下角坐标\n",
    "            width,  # 宽度\n",
    "            height,  # 高度\n",
    "            color=color,\n",
    "            alpha=0.6,\n",
    "            label={\"blue\": \"住宅\", \"green\": \"商业\", \"orange\": \"工业\"}[color]\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 添加图例\n",
    "    handles, labels = plt.gca().get_legend_handles_labels()\n",
    "    by_label = dict(zip(labels, handles))  # 去重\n",
    "    plt.legend(by_label.values(), by_label.keys(), loc=\"upper right\", bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 1.0))\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"随机生成的城市网格及建筑能耗 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    plt.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 能耗可视化\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "    building_df.sort_values(\"energy_consumption\", ascending=False, inplace=True)\n",
    "    plt.bar(building_df.index, building_df[\"energy_consumption\"], color=\"skyblue\")\n",
    "    plt.xlabel(\"建筑物编号\")\n",
    "    plt.ylabel(\"能源消耗\")\n",
    "    plt.title(\"建筑物能源消耗分布\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成城市并计算能耗\n",
    "generate_city_with_energy(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5)"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import random\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置随机种子，确保结果可复现\n",
    "random.seed(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_energy_consumption(building):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    根据建筑属性计算能源消耗。\n",
    "    能耗公式：能耗 = 面积 * 层数 * 功能系数 * 年份系数\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    area = building[\"width\"] * building[\"height\"]\n",
    "    floors = building[\"floors\"]\n",
    "    function_factor = {\"residential\": 1.0, \"commercial\": 1.5, \"industrial\": 2.0}[building[\"function\"]]\n",
    "    year_factor = 1.0 if building[\"year_built\"] >= 2000 else 1.2  # 2000年后建筑更节能\n",
    "    energy_consumption = area * floors * function_factor * year_factor\n",
    "    return energy_consumption\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_distance_to_main_road(building, roads):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    计算建筑到最近主干道的距离\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    min_distance = float('inf')\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        if road[2][\"type\"] == \"main\":\n",
    "            start, end = road[0], road[1]\n",
    "            # 计算建筑中心点到道路线段的距离\n",
    "            building_x, building_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "            road_x1, road_y1 = start\n",
    "            road_x2, road_y2 = end\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 计算点到线段的距离\n",
    "            if road_x1 == road_x2:  # 垂直道路\n",
    "                distance = abs(building_x - road_x1)\n",
    "            else:  # 水平道路\n",
    "                distance = abs(building_y - road_y1)\n",
    "            \n",
    "            min_distance = min(min_distance, distance)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return min_distance\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_accessibility(distance):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    根据距离计算可达性（距离越近，可达性越高）\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    return 1 / (1 + distance)\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_transportation_energy(building, accessibility):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    计算交通能耗（可达性越低，交通能耗越高）\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    base_energy = building[\"energy_consumption\"] * 0.1  # 基础交通能耗为建筑能耗的10%\n",
    "    return base_energy * (2 - accessibility)  # 可达性越低，能耗越高\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_with_energy_and_accessibility(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成城市道路和建筑物的网格，并计算建筑物的能源消耗和可达性。\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 初始化道路和建筑物数据\n",
    "    roads = []\n",
    "    buildings = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历网格，生成横向和纵向道路\n",
    "    for x in range(grid_size):\n",
    "        for y in range(grid_size):\n",
    "            # 横向道路\n",
    "            if x < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x + 1, y), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"main\"}))\n",
    "            # 纵向道路\n",
    "            if y < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x, y + 1), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": \"secondary\"}))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历道路，生成建筑物\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2\n",
    "        mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            building = {\n",
    "                \"center\": (mid_x + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3), mid_y + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)),\n",
    "                \"width\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"height\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"floors\": random.randint(1, 5),\n",
    "                \"function\": random.choice([\"residential\", \"commercial\", \"industrial\"]),\n",
    "                \"year_built\": random.randint(1950, 2025)\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "            # 确保建筑物不与其他建筑物重叠\n",
    "            overlap = False\n",
    "            for existing_building in buildings:\n",
    "                ex_center_x, ex_center_y = existing_building[\"center\"]\n",
    "                ex_width, ex_height = existing_building[\"width\"], existing_building[\"height\"]\n",
    "                if abs(building[\"center\"][0] - ex_center_x) < (building[\"width\"] + ex_width) / 2 and \\\n",
    "                   abs(building[\"center\"][1] - ex_center_y) < (building[\"height\"] + ex_height) / 2:\n",
    "                    overlap = True\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "            if not overlap:\n",
    "                buildings.append(building)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 计算每栋建筑的能源消耗\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        building[\"energy_consumption\"] = calculate_energy_consumption(building)\n",
    "        building[\"distance_to_main_road\"] = calculate_distance_to_main_road(building, roads)\n",
    "        building[\"accessibility\"] = calculate_accessibility(building[\"distance_to_main_road\"])\n",
    "        building[\"transportation_energy\"] = calculate_transportation_energy(building, building[\"accessibility\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 将建筑物数据转换为表格\n",
    "    building_data = [{\n",
    "        \"center\": building[\"center\"],\n",
    "        \"width\": building[\"width\"],\n",
    "        \"height\": building[\"height\"],\n",
    "        \"floors\": building[\"floors\"],\n",
    "        \"function\": building[\"function\"],\n",
    "        \"year_built\": building[\"year_built\"],\n",
    "        \"energy_consumption\": building[\"energy_consumption\"],\n",
    "        \"distance_to_main_road\": building[\"distance_to_main_road\"],\n",
    "        \"accessibility\": building[\"accessibility\"],\n",
    "        \"transportation_energy\": building[\"transportation_energy\"]\n",
    "    } for building in buildings]\n",
    "\n",
    "    building_df = pd.DataFrame(building_data)\n",
    "    print(\"\\n建筑物数据：\")\n",
    "    print(building_df)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 创建颜色映射\n",
    "    energy_values = [b[\"energy_consumption\"] for b in buildings]\n",
    "    min_energy = min(energy_values)\n",
    "    max_energy = max(energy_values)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 创建颜色映射（从浅到深）\n",
    "    cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('energy_cmap', ['#FFE4E1', '#FF0000'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制城市网格\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制道路\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        color = \"black\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"gray\"\n",
    "        ax.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], color=color, linewidth=road_data[\"width\"] * 10, alpha=0.8,\n",
    "                label=\"主路\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"次路\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 根据能耗值设置颜色\n",
    "        normalized_energy = (building[\"energy_consumption\"] - min_energy) / (max_energy - min_energy)\n",
    "        color = cmap(normalized_energy)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),\n",
    "            width,\n",
    "            height,\n",
    "            color=color,\n",
    "            alpha=0.6\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 添加颜色条\n",
    "    sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap, norm=plt.Normalize(min_energy, max_energy))\n",
    "    plt.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, label='能源消耗')\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"城市建筑能耗分布图 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    ax.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制可达性分布图\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 10))\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 创建可达性颜色映射（从深到浅）\n",
    "    accessibility_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('accessibility_cmap', ['#FF0000', '#FFE4E1'])\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 绘制道路\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        color = \"black\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"gray\"\n",
    "        ax.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], color=color, linewidth=road_data[\"width\"] * 10, alpha=0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 根据可达性设置颜色\n",
    "        color = accessibility_cmap(building[\"accessibility\"])\n",
    "        \n",
    "        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),\n",
    "            width,\n",
    "            height,\n",
    "            color=color,\n",
    "            alpha=0.6\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 添加颜色条\n",
    "    sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=accessibility_cmap, norm=plt.Normalize(0, 1))\n",
    "    plt.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, label='可达性')\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"城市建筑可达性分布图 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    ax.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成城市并计算能耗和可达性\n",
    "generate_city_with_energy_and_accessibility(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# （1）根据建筑物能耗的数值，颜色由浅入深表示由小到大，绘制结果。\n",
    "# （2）计算每个建筑到最近的主干道的距离，并根据这个数值得出每栋建筑的可达性，使用可达性，计算建筑与道路耦合的交通能耗数值并形成数据表格，并记录到道路数据中。\n",
    "# （3）添加数据可视化功能，展示建筑能耗与可达性的关系。"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import random\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置随机种子，确保结果可复现\n",
    "random.seed(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 设置中文字体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['SimHei']  # 使用黑体\n",
    "plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False   # 解决负号显示问题\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_energy_consumption(building):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    根据建筑属性计算能源消耗。\n",
    "    能耗公式：能耗 = 面积 * 层数 * 功能系数 * 年份系数\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    area = building[\"width\"] * building[\"height\"]\n",
    "    floors = building[\"floors\"]\n",
    "    function_factor = {\"residential\": 1.0, \"commercial\": 1.5, \"industrial\": 2.0}[building[\"function\"]]\n",
    "    year_factor = 1.0 if building[\"year_built\"] >= 2000 else 1.2  # 2000年后建筑更节能\n",
    "    energy_consumption = area * floors * function_factor * year_factor\n",
    "    return energy_consumption\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_distance_to_main_road(building, roads):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    计算建筑到最近主干道的距离\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    min_distance = float('inf')\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        if road[2][\"type\"] == \"main\":\n",
    "            start, end = road[0], road[1]\n",
    "            # 计算建筑中心点到道路线段的距离\n",
    "            building_x, building_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "            road_x1, road_y1 = start\n",
    "            road_x2, road_y2 = end\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # 计算点到线段的距离\n",
    "            if road_x1 == road_x2:  # 垂直道路\n",
    "                distance = abs(building_x - road_x1)\n",
    "            else:  # 水平道路\n",
    "                distance = abs(building_y - road_y1)\n",
    "            \n",
    "            min_distance = min(min_distance, distance)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 如果没有主干道，设置一个默认较大距离\n",
    "    if min_distance == float('inf'):\n",
    "        min_distance = 10.0\n",
    "        \n",
    "    return min_distance\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_accessibility(distance):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    根据距离计算可达性（距离越近，可达性越高）\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    return 1 / (1 + distance)\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_transportation_energy(building, accessibility):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    计算交通能耗（可达性越低，交通能耗越高）\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    base_energy = building[\"energy_consumption\"] * 0.1  # 基础交通能耗为建筑能耗的10%\n",
    "    return base_energy * (2 - accessibility)  # 可达性越低，能耗越高\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_city_with_energy_and_accessibility(grid_size, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    生成城市道路和建筑物的网格，并计算建筑物的能源消耗和可达性。\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # 初始化道路和建筑物数据\n",
    "    roads = []\n",
    "    buildings = []\n",
    "    road_traffic_energy = {}  # 用于存储每条道路的交通能耗\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历网格，生成横向和纵向道路\n",
    "    for x in range(grid_size):\n",
    "        for y in range(grid_size):\n",
    "            # 横向道路\n",
    "            if x < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                road_type = \"main\" if random.random() > 0.5 else \"secondary\"\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x + 1, y), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": road_type, \"traffic_energy\": 0}))\n",
    "            # 纵向道路\n",
    "            if y < grid_size - 1 and random.random() < road_probability:\n",
    "                road_type = \"main\" if random.random() > 0.5 else \"secondary\"\n",
    "                roads.append(((x, y), (x, y + 1), {\"width\": random.uniform(0.1, 0.3), \"type\": road_type, \"traffic_energy\": 0}))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 遍历道路，生成建筑物\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        mid_x = (start[0] + end[0]) / 2\n",
    "        mid_y = (start[1] + end[1]) / 2\n",
    "\n",
    "        if random.random() < building_probability:\n",
    "            building = {\n",
    "                \"center\": (mid_x + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3), mid_y + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)),\n",
    "                \"width\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"height\": random.uniform(0.2, 0.5),\n",
    "                \"floors\": random.randint(1, 5),\n",
    "                \"function\": random.choice([\"residential\", \"commercial\", \"industrial\"]),\n",
    "                \"year_built\": random.randint(1950, 2025),\n",
    "                \"nearest_road\": road  # 记录最近的道路\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "            # 确保建筑物不与其他建筑物重叠\n",
    "            overlap = False\n",
    "            for existing_building in buildings:\n",
    "                ex_center_x, ex_center_y = existing_building[\"center\"]\n",
    "                ex_width, ex_height = existing_building[\"width\"], existing_building[\"height\"]\n",
    "                if abs(building[\"center\"][0] - ex_center_x) < (building[\"width\"] + ex_width) / 2 and \\\n",
    "                   abs(building[\"center\"][1] - ex_center_y) < (building[\"height\"] + ex_height) / 2:\n",
    "                    overlap = True\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "            if not overlap:\n",
    "                buildings.append(building)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 计算每栋建筑的能源消耗和交通能耗\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        building[\"energy_consumption\"] = calculate_energy_consumption(building)\n",
    "        building[\"distance_to_main_road\"] = calculate_distance_to_main_road(building, roads)\n",
    "        building[\"accessibility\"] = calculate_accessibility(building[\"distance_to_main_road\"])\n",
    "        building[\"transportation_energy\"] = calculate_transportation_energy(building, building[\"accessibility\"])\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 将交通能耗添加到最近道路的记录中\n",
    "        road_id = f\"{building['nearest_road'][0]}-{building['nearest_road'][1]}\"\n",
    "        if road_id not in road_traffic_energy:\n",
    "            road_traffic_energy[road_id] = 0\n",
    "        road_traffic_energy[road_id] += building[\"transportation_energy\"]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 更新道路的交通能耗数据\n",
    "        building[\"nearest_road\"][2][\"traffic_energy\"] += building[\"transportation_energy\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 将建筑物数据转换为表格\n",
    "    building_data = [{\n",
    "        \"center\": building[\"center\"],\n",
    "        \"width\": building[\"width\"],\n",
    "        \"height\": building[\"height\"],\n",
    "        \"floors\": building[\"floors\"],\n",
    "        \"function\": building[\"function\"],\n",
    "        \"year_built\": building[\"year_built\"],\n",
    "        \"energy_consumption\": building[\"energy_consumption\"],\n",
    "        \"distance_to_main_road\": building[\"distance_to_main_road\"],\n",
    "        \"accessibility\": building[\"accessibility\"],\n",
    "        \"transportation_energy\": building[\"transportation_energy\"]\n",
    "    } for building in buildings]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 将道路数据转换为表格\n",
    "    road_data = [{\n",
    "        \"start\": road[0], \n",
    "        \"end\": road[1], \n",
    "        \"width\": road[2][\"width\"], \n",
    "        \"type\": road[2][\"type\"], \n",
    "        \"traffic_energy\": road[2][\"traffic_energy\"]\n",
    "    } for road in roads]\n",
    "\n",
    "    building_df = pd.DataFrame(building_data)\n",
    "    road_df = pd.DataFrame(road_data)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    print(\"\\n建筑物数据：\")\n",
    "    print(building_df)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    print(\"\\n道路交通能耗数据：\")\n",
    "    print(road_df)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 创建颜色映射\n",
    "    energy_values = [b[\"energy_consumption\"] for b in buildings]\n",
    "    min_energy = min(energy_values) if energy_values else 0\n",
    "    max_energy = max(energy_values) if energy_values else 1\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 创建颜色映射（从浅到深）\n",
    "    cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('energy_cmap', ['#FFE4E1', '#FF0000'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制城市网格 - 能耗图\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制道路\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        color = \"black\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"gray\"\n",
    "        ax.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], color=color, linewidth=road_data[\"width\"] * 10, alpha=0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物\n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 根据能耗值设置颜色\n",
    "        normalized_energy = (building[\"energy_consumption\"] - min_energy) / (max_energy - min_energy) if max_energy != min_energy else 0.5\n",
    "        color = cmap(normalized_energy)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),\n",
    "            width,\n",
    "            height,\n",
    "            color=color,\n",
    "            alpha=0.6\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 添加图例\n",
    "    main_road = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='black', lw=4, label='主干道')\n",
    "    secondary_road = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='gray', lw=4, label='次干道')\n",
    "    ax.legend(handles=[main_road, secondary_road], loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 添加颜色条\n",
    "    sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap, norm=plt.Normalize(min_energy, max_energy))\n",
    "    plt.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, label='建筑能源消耗')\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"城市建筑能耗分布图 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    ax.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制交通能耗图\n",
    "    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 10))\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 绘制道路\n",
    "    for road in roads:\n",
    "        start, end, road_data = road\n",
    "        color = \"black\" if road_data[\"type\"] == \"main\" else \"gray\"\n",
    "        ax.plot([start[0], end[0]], [start[1], end[1]], color=color, linewidth=road_data[\"width\"] * 10, alpha=0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 绘制建筑物 - 根据交通能耗着色\n",
    "    trans_values = [b[\"transportation_energy\"] for b in buildings]\n",
    "    min_trans = min(trans_values) if trans_values else 0\n",
    "    max_trans = max(trans_values) if trans_values else 1\n",
    "    trans_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('trans_cmap', ['#90EE90', '#006400'])  # 从浅绿到深绿\n",
    "    \n",
    "    for building in buildings:\n",
    "        center_x, center_y = building[\"center\"]\n",
    "        width = building[\"width\"]\n",
    "        height = building[\"height\"]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 根据交通能耗设置颜色\n",
    "        normalized_trans = (building[\"transportation_energy\"] - min_trans) / (max_trans - min_trans) if max_trans != min_trans else 0.5\n",
    "        color = trans_cmap(normalized_trans)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle(\n",
    "            (center_x - width / 2, center_y - height / 2),\n",
    "            width,\n",
    "            height,\n",
    "            color=color,\n",
    "            alpha=0.6\n",
    "        ))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 添加图例\n",
    "    main_road = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='black', lw=4, label='主干道')\n",
    "    secondary_road = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='gray', lw=4, label='次干道')\n",
    "    ax.legend(handles=[main_road, secondary_road], loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 添加颜色条\n",
    "    sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=trans_cmap, norm=plt.Normalize(min_trans, max_trans))\n",
    "    plt.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, label='建筑交通能耗')\n",
    "\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"城市建筑交通能耗分布图 ({grid_size}x{grid_size})\")\n",
    "    ax.axis(\"equal\")\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 调用函数生成城市并计算能耗和可达性\n",
    "generate_city_with_energy_and_accessibility(grid_size=10, road_probability=0.7, building_probability=0.5)"

    "    for district_id in range(max(districts) + 1):\n",
    "        district_buildings = [b for b in buildings if b[\"district\"] == district_id]\n",
    "        district_roads = []  # 简化处理，不考虑区域内特定道路\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 计算区域指标\n",
    "        density_indicators = calculate_density_indicators(district_buildings, grid_size/2)\n",
    "        mix_indicators = calculate_mix_indicators(district_buildings)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 存储区域数据\n",
    "        district_data[district_id] = {\n",
    "            \"buildings\": district_buildings,\n",
    "            \"density\": density_indicators,\n",
    "            \"mix\": mix_indicators,\n",
    "            \"avg_building_energy\": np.mean([b[\"energy_consumption\"] for b in district_buildings]) if district_buildings else 0,\n",
    "            \"avg_transportation_energy\": np.mean([b[\"transportation_energy\"] for b in district_buildings]) if district_buildings else 0,\n",
    "            \"total_energy\": sum(b[\"total_energy\"] for b in district_buildings)\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==== 5. 计算整体城市形态指标 ====\n",
    "    print(\"第5步: 计算整体城市指标...\")\n",
    "    city_density = calculate_density_indicators(buildings, grid_size)\n",
    "    city_mix = calculate_mix_indicators(buildings)\n",
    "    city_connectivity = calculate_connectivity_indicators(roads, grid_size)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 计算城市级别的总能耗\n",
    "    city_building_energy = sum(b[\"energy_consumption\"] for b in buildings)\n",
    "    city_transportation_energy = sum(b[\"transportation_energy\"] for b in buildings)\n",
    "    city_total_energy = city_building_energy + city_transportation_energy\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==== 6. 将建筑物和道路数据转换为表格 ====\n",
    "    print(\"第6步: 准备数据可视化...\")\n",
    "    building_data = [{\n",
    "        \"center\": building[\"center\"],\n",
    "        \"width\": building[\"width\"],\n",
    "        \"height\": building[\"height\"],\n",
    "        \"floors\": building[\"floors\"],\n",
    "        \"function\": building[\"function\"],\n",
    "        \"year_built\": building[\"year_built\"],\n",
    "        \"district\": building[\"district\"],\n",
    "        \"energy_consumption\": building[\"energy_consumption\"],\n",
    "        \"accessibility\": building[\"accessibility\"],\n",
    "        \"transportation_energy\": building[\"transportation_energy\"],\n",
    "        \"total_energy\": building[\"total_energy\"]\n",
    "    } for building in buildings]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    road_data = [{\n",
    "        \"start\": road[0], \n",
    "        \"end\": road[1], \n",
    "        \"width\": road[2][\"width\"], \n",
    "        \"type\": road[2][\"type\"], \n",
    "        \"traffic_energy\": road[2][\"traffic_energy\"],\n",
    "        \"capacity\": road[2][\"capacity\"]\n",
    "    } for road in roads]\n",
    "\n",
    "    building_df = pd.DataFrame(building_data)\n",
    "    road_df = pd.DataFrame(road_data)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 创建颜色映射\n",
    "    energy_values = [b[\"energy_consumption\"] for b in buildings]\n",
    "    min_energy = min(energy_values) if energy_values else 0\n",
    "    max_energy = max(energy_values) if energy_values else 1\n",
    "    \n",
    "    trans_values = [b[\"transportation_energy\"] for b in buildings]\n",
    "    min_trans = min(trans_values) if trans_values else 0\n",
    "    max_trans = max(trans_values) if trans_values else 1\n",
    "    \n",
    "    total_values = [b[\"total_energy\"] for b in buildings]\n",
    "    min_total = min(total_values) if total_values else 0\n",
    "    max_total = max(total_values) if total_values else 1\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 创建颜色映射（从浅到深）\n",
    "    building_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('building_cmap', ['#FFE4E1', '#FF0000'])\n",
    "    trans_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('trans_cmap', ['#E0F7FA', '#006064'])\n",
    "    total_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('total_cmap', ['#F1F8E9', '#33691E'])\n",
    "    district_colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728', '#9467bd', '#8c564b']"
   ]
